create_MomentsRescaler: create a MomentsRescaler to normalize tensors by subtracting the running mean and dividing by running standard deviation
create_RMSRescaler: create an RMSRescaler to normalize tensors by dividing by the running root mean square value
create_StdRescaler: create a StdRescaler to normalize tensors by dividing by the running standard deviation without mean subtraction
create_SignedHyperbolicRescaler: create a SignedHyperbolicRescaler to apply the transformed Bellman operator rescaling from arxiv 1805.11593
review_Rescaler: review the Rescaler abstract base class and its rescale and recover methods for tensor normalization
